message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the described facts.

Facts: In Dec 2010, the legal representative and executive director of a company, together with others, introduced to a contractor's agent that their project is a key project, with full procedures, investment already in place, to deceive the agent into signing a construction contract. The contract price is 50 million, start date Dec 28, 2010. They obtained a guarantee deposit etc, defrauding the agent of RMB 137,800, of which one accomplice got 26,500.

Thus crimes: fraud (诈骗罪) – specifically "诈骗" (defrauding money). Also possibly "非法获取财物" but that's fraud. Also "合同诈骗" maybe "诈骗罪" covers. Could also be "非法占有" but that's part of fraud.

Also "非法获取保证金" maybe "诈骗" covers. Could there be "非法经营" no. "伪造" no. "敲诈勒索" no. So only fraud.

Thus answer: [诈骗罪]<eoa>
